target_customer: Provider groups, hospitals and medical practices (website customers are mostly small specialty practices)
problem: Healthcare staff spend time on repetitive administrative work such as referrals, scheduling and claims.
business_model: B2B SaaS selling AI agents or automated workflows to healthcare practices

founders.name: Lance Rodela
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as the founder. Aggregator profiles mention earlier product roles, but they were not opened, so not recorded here.

technical_complexity.rationale: Automating workflows inside EHRs and payer portals needs integration work and HIPAA compliance, with ordinary software engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Embedded EHR workflows and compliance agreements create some stickiness, but automation tools were widely available.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying the company; later competitors in prior authorization automation raised money in the 2020s.

market_need_then: Administrative burden in healthcare is widely documented, but no dated demand source specific to this company was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses shifthealth.io; no purchase story found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain enterprise healthcare software; BAA and HIPAA messaging on the site

branding.community_and_virality: None found. Several unrelated companies use Shift Health or similar names.

brand_strength.rationale: A generic name shared with other companies and no press about the brand.

pivots.from: Automating manual healthcare workflows for large provider groups and hospitals
pivots.to: AI agents for healthcare practices covering patient access and revenue cycle
pivots.why: Not stated; website now sells AI agents inside the practice EHR

outcome_analysis: Shift Health is a Utah company in YC Summer 2019 that automates healthcare administrative tasks, now marketed as AI agents for referrals, scheduling and claims, with a 2026 copyright and ten named practice customers. No funding beyond an aggregator figure was found and no press coverage, so its trajectory is unknown; it appears small and still operating.
notes: CB Insights and VCBacked (search results only) report about 150K from Y Combinator and Kli Capital in August 2019; unverified, no round recorded. CB Insights says founded 2018 in Provo while YC says Lehi. Other companies named Shift Health (Toronto consultancy, an AI mental health app) exist and are excluded. No dated 2019 competitor source was found; later prior-authorization startups postdate the batch.
